recorded_text: A belt on the hydroponic lamps snaps. The beds will fail if nobody climbs in.
current_text: The drive belt on the hydroponic lamps has snapped. Without light the beds will die this week. The only spare belt is on a workshop machine.

recorded_text: A crowd is at the yard gate with a story about a collapse north of Atlantic Av.
current_text: Five people are at the gate. Their tunnel north of Atlantic Av collapsed and they have nowhere else to go. Five more mouths, and five more pairs of hands.

recorded_text: Mara says the air filters are pulling dust. Someone has to open the stacks.
current_text: Mara says the charcoal in the air filters is clogged and dust is getting into the passages. To clean it, one filter has to stop for a while.

recorded_text: Jonah and Owen are shouting about who ate the extra rations.
current_text: Jonah and Owen are shouting across the platform about who ate the extra rations. Everyone has stopped work to watch.

recorded_text: Ellis is preaching the Synod's line by the filter room. A few of yours are listening.
current_text: Ellis is preaching the Synod's teaching by the filter room, and a few of your people have stopped to listen. Let it go on, and the Synod takes root on your station.

recorded_text: Fran can move a crate through Bowling Green. No receipt.
current_text: Fran has a crate brought in through Bowling Green. No stamp, no receipt, and it is worth good tokens. The Exchange traders will take a refusal badly.

recorded_text: Lila's dig crew hits a hollow. Dust pours into the lower level.
current_text: Lila's dig crew has broken into a hollow and dust is pouring into the lower level. Props will cost materials. Dig on without them and someone will breathe that dust and fall sick.

recorded_text: June's radio, or a pipe that sounds like one, says a word twice: Floor.
current_text: In the static on June's radio, or in a pipe that sounds like one, a voice says one word twice: "Floor". June asks whether she should write down what she hears.

recorded_text: Benny waves in a handcar from the Exchange side. The sacks of food are real. The price is not kind.
current_text: Benny waves in a handcar from the Exchange side. The sacks of food are real, but the price is steep.

recorded_text: Two residents walked into the tunnel toward the river. They left their tags.
current_text: In the night two residents walked off into the tunnel toward the river. They left their name tags on their bunks. A crew could still catch them.

recorded_text: Mara's crew pulls a spool of cable out of a sealed locker. It is Depot stock, forgotten.
current_text: Mara's crew finds a spool of cable in a sealed locker: old Depot stock nobody remembers. Use it yourselves, or sell it.

recorded_text: Ruth and two others on the platform are coughing into their sleeves.
current_text: Ruth and two others on the platform are coughing into their sleeves. Put them to bed and the cough may stop with them. Keep them working and it will spread.

recorded_text: Pete finds a drip over the bunks. It will be a stream if nobody patches it.
current_text: Pete finds water dripping over the bunks. Left alone it will get worse, and when the flood comes the water will reach the rooms.

recorded_text: Hal is walking the platform again. The night shift wants him off the tools.
current_text: Hal can't sleep and walks the platform all night. The night shift says he is a danger at the machines and wants him kept away from the tools.

recorded_text: Owen counts the bowls twice and says the kitchen is short a meal.
current_text: Owen counts the bowls twice: tonight there is one meal too few. Either everyone eats a little less, or someone goes hungry until tomorrow.

recorded_text: Samira's drill is gone from the workshop peg. Someone borrowed it and did not bring it back.
current_text: Samira's drill is gone from its peg in the workshop. Someone borrowed it and never brought it back.

recorded_text: Ada asks for a curtain between the bunks. It is a small thing, and the room is listening.
current_text: Ada asks for a curtain between the bunks. It is a small thing, and everyone is waiting to see how you answer.

recorded_text: Nora tastes salt in the air by the east wall. The river is closer than the map says.
current_text: Nora tastes salt in the air by the east wall. There is a crack there, and the river is closer than the map says.

recorded_text: Vic has a pile of scrap that could be parts or could be a fight about who owns it.
current_text: Vic has gathered a pile of scrap. The workshop could use it, but Vic says it is his, and taking it will cause bad blood.

recorded_text: Rob will not leave the belt. The next shift is standing there with their hands empty.
current_text: Rob has worked two shifts in a row and will not leave his machine. The next shift is standing behind him with nothing to do.

recorded_text: Tess starts a hymn in the passage. It is not the Synod's hymn. People join anyway.
current_text: Tess starts a hymn in the passage. It is not a Synod hymn. People join in anyway.

recorded_text: Paul swears he can drive a handcar to the ferry the way he used to. The tunnel is not on your map.
current_text: Paul swears he can still drive a handcar to the ferry by his old route. That tunnel is not on your map. If he gets through, more stations will hear of you.

recorded_text: The lost crop is still the story at meals. The next belt looks thin.
current_text: The lost crop is still talked about at meals. The next belt looks worn too.

recorded_text: The people you turned away left a mark on the gate. A child is asking for them by name.
current_text: The people you turned away left a mark on the gate. A child keeps calling their names.

recorded_text: Mara's crew still talks about the shift they shut the filter to clean it. The dust is back.
current_text: Mara's crew still talks about the shift they stopped the filter to clean it. The dust is back.

recorded_text: Jonah and Owen are louder than last time. Sending them back to work did not end it.
current_text: Jonah and Owen are louder than last time. Sending them back to work did not settle it.

recorded_text: Pete's patch held for a while. The drip has found a new seam.
current_text: The cloth held the first seam. Pete found one more, smaller.

recorded_text: The scouts stop at a rusted blast door on the dead Queens branch. It smells of damp, machine oil and something sickly sweet. Behind the door is a pre-war medical store, and the tunnel is breathing far too quietly.
current_text: The scouts stop at a rusted blast door on the dead Queens branch. It smells of damp, machine oil and something sickly sweet. Behind the door is a pre-war medical store. The tunnel around it is far too quiet.

recorded_text: The metal gives with a deafening screech and whatever lives there scatters. The team hauls out crates of alcohol and bandages.
current_text: The metal gives with a screech and whatever lives in there scatters. The team carries out crates of alcohol and bandages.

recorded_text: The bolt won't budge and the noise brings a pack of blind dogs. The team retreats with bitten legs.
current_text: The bolt will not move, and the noise brings a pack of blind dogs. The team falls back with bitten legs.

recorded_text: You spot a bat roost right over the passage and slip round it through the vents. The haul is yours without a shot fired.
current_text: You spot a bat roost right over the passage and slip round it through the vents. The supplies are yours without a fight.

recorded_text: The beam lands right on the swarm. Half the underground wakes up and the scouts come back empty-handed and badly hurt.
current_text: The beam lands right on the swarm. Everything down there wakes up, and the scouts come back empty-handed and badly hurt.

recorded_text: Purple mold has broken out in the gardens. The slime eats the crop at a frightening pace, and if nothing is done the station goes on a diet of dried rat tails. The workers are banging canisters on the pipes in panic.
current_text: Purple mold has broken out in the hydroponic beds. It is eating the crop fast, and if nothing is done the station will be living on dried rat tails. The growers are banging on the pipes in panic.

recorded_text: The steel in your voice shuts the panickers up and they pick up knives. The gardens are saved, but a couple of people are coughing.
current_text: Your voice cuts through the panic and they pick up knives. The beds are saved, but a couple of people are coughing.

recorded_text: The workers refuse to go into the toxic muck. Time runs out and the mold eats a third of the crop.
current_text: The growers refuse to climb into the poisoned muck. Time runs out and the mold eats a third of the crop.

recorded_text: The mix works perfectly. The mold hisses and falls as grey ash, and the beds survive.
current_text: The mix works. The mold hisses and falls away as grey ash, and the beds survive.

recorded_text: The numbers were wrong. The fumes flash and take out half the rack, and the grower breathes the smoke. Half the food stores are gone.
current_text: The sums were wrong. The fumes catch fire and take half the rack with them, and the grower breathes the smoke. Half the food stores are gone.

recorded_text: Shovels scrape and voices mutter in the upper shafts. The Moles are filling the filters with earth, convinced that surface air defiles their holy dark. The station starts to choke.
current_text: Shovels scrape and voices mutter in the upper shafts. The Moles are packing the air filters with earth: they believe surface air defiles their holy dark. The station is starting to choke.

recorded_text: Your speech about one darkness for all moves the madman. The Moles take their buckets and go to pray in other tunnels.
current_text: Your talk of one darkness for everyone reaches him. The Moles pick up their buckets and go to pray in other tunnels.

recorded_text: The cultist calls you a heretic and throws a sulfur smoke bomb through the grate. The level has to be evacuated for a while.
current_text: Their leader calls you a heretic and throws a sulphur smoke bomb through the grate. The level has to be cleared for a while.

recorded_text: A soft click of the knife and the fanatics drop screaming down the shaft. Solved, permanently and cynically. The station breathes, but people whisper about it.
current_text: The knife clicks once and the cradles fall down the shaft. The problem is gone for good. The station breathes again, but people whisper about how.

recorded_text: You knock a rusty bolt and the tools clatter down. The Moles spot you and rain stones into the shaft.
current_text: You knock a rusty bolt and your tools clatter down the shaft. The Moles see you and throw stones down after you.

recorded_text: The main diesel chokes and dies: someone jammed a steel crowbar into the gears. The lights go out, sirens wail and the filters start to cool. This needs a fast, ugly fix.
current_text: The main diesel chokes and dies: someone has jammed a steel crowbar into the gears. The lights go out, the sirens wail and the filters start to cool. This needs a fast, rough fix.

recorded_text: The improvisation works. The diesel coughs black smoke but keeps life support running.
current_text: It holds. The diesel coughs black smoke, but life support keeps running.

recorded_text: The hoses burst and flood the room with fuel. The repair will take twice as long.
current_text: The hoses burst and spray fuel across the room. The repair will take twice as long.

recorded_text: One heavy blow frees the flywheel and the pistons pump again. The lights are back.
current_text: One heavy blow frees the flywheel and the pistons start pumping again. The lights come back.

recorded_text: The hammer bounces into the panel and burns out the copper windings. The station goes dark and a resident takes a bad shock.
current_text: The hammer glances off into the panel and burns out the copper windings. The station goes dark, and a resident takes a bad shock.

recorded_text: Slick types in neon vests from Showtime slip onto the station. Under their coats: contraband Dolce syrup and a crate of racing rats. They offer to run a betting night to lift the workers' spirits.
current_text: Smooth talkers in neon vests from Showtime have slipped onto the station. Under their coats: contraband Dolce syrup and a crate of racing rats. They offer to run a betting night to lift the workers' spirits.

recorded_text: Analysis beats chance. The favourite wins and you take triple the pot and the gamblers' respect.
current_text: The favourite wins. You take three times your stake, and the gamblers start to respect you.

recorded_text: The favourite drops dead at the start. The tokens are gone and the workers laugh behind your back.
current_text: The favourite drops dead at the start. The tokens are gone, and the workers laugh behind your back.

recorded_text: Your nerve is backed by authority. The dealers pay their share in tokens and bandages.
current_text: They can see you mean it. The dealers pay their share in tokens and bandages.

recorded_text: Captain Rhee's men have strung a chain across the tunnel on the Jay St side. Every handcar through now pays the Directorate. Jonah says they asked for the yard by name.
current_text: Captain Rhee's men have strung a chain across the tunnel on the Jay St side. Every handcar that passes now pays the Directorate, and Jonah says they asked about your station by name.

recorded_text: Rhee says the toll you paid was only the first instalment. The ledger now has the yard on a monthly line.
current_text: Rhee says the toll you paid was only the first instalment. Your station now has its own line in his ledger, payable every month.

recorded_text: Rhee liked the cable. He wants it every month now, and he has already written it down.
current_text: Rhee liked the cable. Now he wants it every month, and he has already written that down.

recorded_text: Rhee's patrol walked the long way your handcars took. Now he knows where it goes.
current_text: Rhee's patrol walked the long way your handcars took, all the way to the end. Now he knows where it leads.

recorded_text: Rhee is back early. The ledger says the yard is behind, and he brought six men to read it aloud.
current_text: Rhee is back early. His ledger says your station is behind on payments, and he has brought six men to read it out loud.

recorded_text: Fran's route is shut. Rhee's men used it to walk straight to your gate. Fran has not said a word to anyone since.
current_text: Fran's route is shut. Rhee's men used it to walk straight to your gate. Fran has not spoken to anyone since.

recorded_text: Rhee's squad is on the platform. They did not knock.
current_text: Rhee's squad is on the platform. They did not knock. Jonah stands between them and the quarters.

recorded_text: Leo's crew hears knocking behind the rock face. Three slow, three fast. When they stop, it stops.
current_text: Lila's dig crew hears knocking behind the rock face: three slow, three fast. When they stop, it stops.

recorded_text: The knocking answered for a week. Then the rock gave, and a woman crawled through. She is thin to the bone, and she says she came up from the Floor.
current_text: The knocking answered for a week. Then the rock gave way and a woman crawled through, thin to the bone. She says she came up from the Floor.

recorded_text: Leo's cut broke into a dry pocket. A woman was sitting in it with her lamp turned low. She says she came up from the Floor.
current_text: Lila's cut broke into a dry pocket. A woman was sitting in it with her lamp turned low. She says she came up from the Floor.

recorded_text: The fill did not hold. Someone dug through it from the other side. A woman, thin to the bone, says she came up from the Floor.
current_text: The fill did not hold: someone dug through it from the other side. A woman, thin to the bone, says she came up from the Floor.

recorded_text: She has eaten three days running and drawn a map on the back of a ration card. She says the Floor has power, and it is not sharing. Paul knows the first turn on it.
current_text: Three days of meals, and she has drawn a map on the back of a ration card. The Floor has power, she says, and it is not sharing. Paul recognises the first turn on it.

recorded_text: The seal broke from below. The same woman came through again, her hands torn on the rock. She has a map, and she will not go back down.
current_text: The seal broke from below. The same woman came through again, her hands torn on the rock. She has a map, she will not go back down, and Paul is already reading it.

recorded_text: Benny brings a note from Broker Lin. The Exchange will advance the yard tokens now. In a few weeks it wants them back, with a cut on top.
current_text: Benny brings a note from Broker Lin. The Exchange will advance your station tokens now. In a few weeks it wants them back, with more on top.

recorded_text: Lin's collector is at the handcar with the note you signed. The cut is on top, as promised.
current_text: Lin's collector is at Benny's handcar with the note you signed. The interest is on top, as agreed.

recorded_text: Lin's collector stops by anyway. The Exchange remembers who turned its money down, and wants a show of goodwill.
current_text: Lin's collector stops by Benny's handcar anyway. The Exchange remembers who turned its money down, and it would like a gesture of goodwill.

recorded_text: Kim opens the food store and the air inside is warm and sweet. The top row of sacks is turning. It will not keep another week.
current_text: Kim opens the food store and the air inside is warm and sweet. The top row of sacks is going bad and will not keep another week.

recorded_text: Mina knocks on the last fuel drum and it rings high. The generator will run tonight, but not at full.
current_text: Mina knocks on the last fuel drum and it rings high. The generator will run tonight, but not at full power unless it gets something to burn.

recorded_text: Chris caught Drew leaving the kitchen with a ration inside his coat. Drew says it was for Ann, who has been too sick to stand in line for two days. The whole platform saw it.
current_text: Chris caught Drew leaving the kitchen with a ration inside his coat. Drew says it was for Ann, who has been too sick to stand in the queue for two days. The whole platform saw it.

recorded_text: Owen found a Directorate man asleep behind the generator. He took his armband off before he lay down. He asks not to be sent back to Rhee.
current_text: Owen found a Directorate man asleep behind the generator. He took off his armband before he lay down. He asks not to be sent back to Captain Rhee.

recorded_text: Лента на лампах гидропоники лопается. Грядки пропадут, если никто не залезет.
current_text: На фитолампах лопнул приводной ремень. Без света грядки погибнут за неделю. Запасной ремень есть только на станке в мастерской.

recorded_text: У ворот двора толпа. Рассказывают об обвале к северу от Атлантик-авеню.
current_text: У ворот пятеро. Их тоннель к северу от Атлантик-авеню обвалился, идти им больше некуда. Пять лишних ртов и пять пар рук.

recorded_text: Мара говорит, фильтры тянут пыль. Кто-то должен открыть слои.
current_text: Мара говорит, что уголь в воздушных фильтрах забился и пыль идёт в проходы. Чтобы вычистить, один фильтр придётся на время остановить.

recorded_text: Джона и Оуэн орут, кто съел лишний паёк.
current_text: Джона и Оуэн на всю платформу спорят, кто съел лишний паёк. Все бросили работу и смотрят.

recorded_text: Эллис проповедует линию Синода у фильтров. Несколько ваших слушают.
current_text: Эллис у фильтровой проповедует учение Синода, и несколько твоих людей остановились послушать. Если не мешать, Синод пустит на станции корни.

recorded_text: Фрэн может провести ящик через Боулинг-Грин. Без расписки.
current_text: Фрэн предлагает ящик, пронесённый через Боулинг-Грин. Ни клейма, ни расписки, зато товар стоит хороших жетонов. Отказ заденет торговцев Биржи.

recorded_text: Бригада Лилы натыкается на пустоту. Пыль сыплется на нижний уровень.
current_text: Бригада Лилы пробила пустоту, и на нижний ярус сыплется пыль. Крепь обойдётся в материалы. Если копать дальше без неё, кто-то наглотается пыли и сляжет.

recorded_text: Радио Джун, или труба, похожая на радио, дважды говорит слово: Этаж.
current_text: Сквозь шорох в радио Джун, а может, в трубе, которая звучит как радио, голос дважды повторяет одно слово: «Этаж». Джун спрашивает, записывать ли то, что она слышит.

recorded_text: Бенни машет дрезине со стороны Биржи. Мешки с едой настоящие. Цена не добрая.
current_text: Бенни зазывает дрезину со стороны Биржи. Мешки с едой настоящие, но цена кусается.

recorded_text: Двое ушли в тоннель к реке. Жетоны оставили.
current_text: Ночью двое ушли в тоннель к реке. Номерки оставили на койках. Если послать бригаду, их ещё можно догнать.

recorded_text: Бригада Мары вытаскивает бухту кабеля из запертого шкафа. Это склад Депо, забытый.
current_text: Бригада Мары нашла в запертом шкафу бухту кабеля. Старый запас Депо, о котором все забыли. Можно пустить в дело самим или продать.

recorded_text: Рут и ещё двое на платформе кашляют в рукав.
current_text: Рут и ещё двое на платформе кашляют в рукав. Если уложить их, кашель, может, на них и остановится. Если оставить на работе, он пойдёт дальше.

recorded_text: Пит находит капель над койками. Если не заделать, будет струя.
current_text: Пит нашёл течь над койками. Если не заделать, закапает сильнее, а в паводок вода пойдёт в комнаты.

recorded_text: Хэл опять ходит по платформе. Ночная смена хочет убрать его от инструмента.
current_text: Хэл не может спать и всю ночь бродит по платформе. Ночная смена говорит, что у станков он опасен, и просит убрать его от инструмента.

recorded_text: Оуэн дважды считает миски и говорит, что на кухне не хватает еды.
current_text: Оуэн дважды пересчитал миски: сегодня одной порции не хватает. Либо все едят чуть меньше, либо кто-то останется голодным до завтра.

recorded_text: Дрели Самиры нет на гвозде в мастерской. Кто-то взял и не вернул.
current_text: Дрели Самиры нет на её крючке в мастерской. Кто-то взял и не вернул.

recorded_text: Эйда просит занавеску между койками. Мелочь, и комната слушает.
current_text: Эйда просит повесить занавеску между койками. Мелочь, но все ждут, что ты ответишь.

recorded_text: Нора чувствует соль у восточной стены. Река ближе, чем на карте.
current_text: Нора чувствует привкус соли у восточной стены. Там трещина, а река ближе, чем показывает карта.

recorded_text: У Вика куча лома. Это либо детали, либо ссора, чьё это.
current_text: Вик натаскал кучу лома. Мастерской он пригодится, но Вик говорит, что лом его, и если забрать, будет обида.

recorded_text: Роб не уходит с ленты. Следующая смена стоит рядом с пустыми руками.
current_text: Роб отработал две смены подряд и не отходит от станка. Следующая смена стоит у него за спиной без дела.

recorded_text: Тесс заводит гимн в проходе. Это не гимн Синода. Люди всё равно подхватывают.
current_text: Тесс запевает в проходе гимн. Не синодский. Люди всё равно подхватывают.

recorded_text: Пол божится, что довезёт дрезину до парома, как раньше. Этого тоннеля нет на вашей карте.
current_text: Пол божится, что доедет на дрезине до парома старым маршрутом. Этого тоннеля на твоей карте нет. Если он пройдёт, о станции узнают дальше по линии.

recorded_text: Новая лента держит. Грядки снова в деле, и бригада знает, кто залез ради этого.
current_text: Новый ремень держит. Грядки снова в деле, и бригада знает, кто полез его менять.

recorded_text: Потерянный урожай всё ещё история за едой. Следующая лента выглядит тонкой.
current_text: За едой всё ещё вспоминают пропавший урожай. Новый ремень тоже на ладан дышит.

recorded_text: У кого-то из принятых снаружи ещё семья. Спрашивают, выдержит ли двор ещё одного.
current_text: У кого-то из принятых снаружи осталась семья. Спрашивают, выдержит ли станция ещё одного.

recorded_text: Те, кого не пустили, оставили метку на воротах. Ребёнок спрашивает их по имени.
current_text: Те, кого не пустили, оставили метку на воротах. Ребёнок зовёт их по именам.

recorded_text: Бригада Мары всё ещё говорит о смене, когда фильтр остановили на чистку. Пыль вернулась.
current_text: Бригада Мары до сих пор вспоминает смену, когда фильтр остановили на чистку. Пыль вернулась.

recorded_text: Джона и Оуэн держали мир, который вы устроили, пока мисок снова не стало мало.
current_text: Джона и Оуэн держали уговор, пока мисок снова не стало мало.

recorded_text: Джона и Оуэн громче, чем в прошлый раз. Работа это не кончила.
current_text: Джона и Оуэн кричат громче прежнего. Отправить их работать не помогло.

recorded_text: Эллис говорит, проповеди, которую вы разрешили, теперь нужна комната, не проход.
current_text: Эллис говорит, что проповеди, раз уж её разрешили, теперь нужна комната, а не проход.

recorded_text: Эллис тише, и те, кого вы увели от проповеди, не забыли.
current_text: Эллис притих, но те, кого увели с проповеди, не забыли.
